programs.title: Navigating The World
programs.desc: Navigating the World journeys down the East Coast of Australia exploring the Great Barrier Reef, the ancient earth of Lake Mungo and the seals of Montague Island.

programs.title: Escape Fishing With ET
programs.desc: Part 2 at Swains Reef. Non stop action, Spanish Mackerel, shark mackerel, monster GT's, long toms. Fishing's red hot and every cast hooks up. Absolute chaos out here!

programs.title: All 4 Adventure
programs.desc: All 4 Adventure: Arnhem Land follows Jase, Simon, and newcomer Mitch as they battle rough tracks, croc-filled rivers, and wild coastlines to uncover the raw beauty of this ancient land.

programs.title: Pat Callinan's 4x4 Adventures
programs.desc: Join Pat Callinan as he makes an ambitious run across Australia to places you can only access with a 4X4. You'll be captivated by the destinations and learn tips from Australia's 4X4 guru.

programs.title: Top Gear Australia
programs.desc: To better understand farming machinery, the hosts become farmers for a day. JLP and the Stig test out a Ford Mustang Dark Horse, and cricket legend Mitchell Johnson goes for a fast lap.

programs.title: JAG
programs.desc: The JAG team led by Commander Harm Rabb investigate another military case. Harm investigates the death of a child and discovers she has a surviving twin sister.
